'''Elora Silssusio''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] commanded the [[Polis Massa Base (Rebel Alliance)|Polis Massa Rebel Base]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

Prior to joining the Alliance, Silssusio led a security company called [[Ulterior Vision]], which did secret work for [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. When the company was exposed by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], Silssusio joined an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Unidentified resistance group (Elora Silssusio)|resistance group]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
